title: The Word Prototype
short_teaser: Prototype comes from roots meaning first and model or form.
story: Prototype comes from roots meaning first and model or form. It describes an early version built to test and learn. A prototype is not a failed final product; it is a tool for discovering what the final product needs. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
